face-api 1.7.12 by Vladimir Mandic (https://github.com/vladmandic/face-api),
MIT licensed, bundling TensorFlow.js (Apache 2.0). The models in models/ are
the face-api.js pretrained weights (MIT). These are the same files the go.cam
open source age verification project ships for its on-device selfie age
estimation (https://github.com/Godotcam/goCamOpenSource).

Only three models are included, the ones Hooky's signup age check needs:
  tiny_face_detector   finds the face
  age_gender           estimates age (gender output is ignored)
  face_expression      the smile / straight-face liveness challenge

All three run inside the browser. Hooky never uploads camera frames.
